question: Is the LGD extract good enough to be the geography spine?

Vintage 2023-11-30/2023-12-01. 125/785 districts (15.9%) have census code '000' (post-2011). No split/merge/rename events published.
implication: VALIDATED and adopted as the spine. Census join ceiling is 660/785 districts.

question: Is Udyam genuinely district-level and LGD-keyed?

'NA' in small (30) and medium (123). last_updated=2023-12-21 for every row, CONTRADICTING the catalogue's 'daily updated' claim.
implication: Usable as a district allocation weight and context only. It counts registered enterprises, never vacancies or employment.

question: Can Census B-24/B-27 be acquired programmatically?
evidence: SSLCertVerificationError: unable to get local issuer certificate. openssl shows subject CN=censusindia.gov.in, issuer 'emSign SSL CA - G1', verify return code 21 (unable to verify the first certificate) - the server omits its intermediate CA. TLSv1.3 otherwise fine.
implication: Server-side incomplete certificate chain, not a block. Certificate verification was NOT disabled. Fix: supply the emSign intermediate, or download via browser.

question: Does an NCS sector -> NCO crosswalk exist?
evidence: Acquired the official NIC-2008 document (193 pages) and extracted 20 section names. All 20 substantive NCS sector categories align one-to-one with NIC-2008 sections A-T (Agriculture=A, Mining=B, Manufacturing=C, Power=D, Water/Sewerage=E, Construction=F, Wholesale&Retail=G, Transport&Storage=H, Hotels/Food=I, IT&Communication=J, Finance&Insurance=K, Real Estate=L, Specialized Professional=M, Operations&Support=N, Public Admin&Defence=O, Education=P, Health=Q, Arts&Entertainment=R, Other Services=S, Household&Domestic=T). ncs.gov.in/Documents/NIC_Sector.pdf returns the Angular SPA shell, not a PDF.
implication: NCS sectors are an INDUSTRY classification. Industry -> occupation is many-to-many, so no official crosswalk exists or can. Defensible route is an empirical P(occupation|industry,state) cross-tab from PLFS.

question: Do state employment portals publish district vacancies openly?

Rojgar Sangam UP: robots permits main site, disallows dev/beta hosts; login required; no datasets or API refs. TN Velaivaaippu: robots.txt 404; no datasets; points to tamilnaducareerservices.tn.gov.in.
implication: robots.txt permission is not data availability. Vacancy data sits behind CAPTCHA/login; not pursued. Formal data request to state directorates is the realistic route.
